summary: Reduces the work needed to open the dashboard and displays full engine names in the Mission Control engine selector.
userImpact: The dashboard opens while statistics and process activity load.
The engine selector displays engine names without internal identifiers.
The dashboard shows a limited-access notice only when the selected engine has resource-level visibility restrictions.
Deleted engines are removed from runtime and project import choices.
Unavailable engines and restricted pages show a plain-language message.
security: Authorization checks continue to use current, tenant-bound grants and roles.
documentation: The existing dashboard and engine inventory endpoints retain their response contracts.
validation: Authorization, dashboard, and engine selector regression checks.

customerDocumentation.reason: The dashboard, engine selection, and administration workflows retain their existing steps. This change corrects the loading and availability states.
